name: mackforge
description: mackforge skills for thinking with Claude.

plugins.name: mackforge-outside
plugins.description: Before committing to an approach, one quick check of what already exists: shipped tools, your other projects, your notes. Verdict first, one next action last.

plugins.name: mackforge-redteam
plugins.description: One adversarial pass that assumes your plan or answer is wrong, finds the most likely fatal flaw, and names the cheapest check that settles it.

plugins.name: mackforge-fanout
plugins.description: Five parallel thinking frames plus a critic on an open-ended problem: scored ideas, the traps each one carries, and the strongest direction.

plugins.name: mackforge-think-twice
plugins.description: Seven skills for thinking with Claude: check prior art, attack a plan, fan out ideas, break a problem down, prove claims, translate jargon, and interview before building.

plugins.name: mackforge-yolo-alchemy
plugins.description: Spend the usage you would otherwise lose at your weekly reset: an overnight run that pairs one of your projects with research from an unrelated field and leaves a short morning brief.
